ps3.title: PS3 game updates
ps3.label: Update PS3 games automatically
ps3.description: PlayOut checks Sony's update server for your PS3 games at start and when one is added, and installs missing updates with RPCS3 into Updates and DLC\PS3 while RPCS3 is closed. A game’s menu also has Update PS3 game.

bios.label: BIOS folder
bios.description: Put your BIOS and firmware files here; PlayOut links every emulator to it.

update.label: Update all emulators
update.first: Set up emulators first; then this updates them.
update.description: Puts in the newest nightly build of every emulator PlayOut installed (stable where none is published), from the same server the emulator’s own updater uses. Settings, saves and the Emulation folder links stay; an emulator that is open is left alone.

updateReport.running: Open, so left alone: close it and update again
updateReport.failed: Could not be updated (the installed build is kept)
updateReport.failedWhy: Could not be updated: {error} (the installed build is kept)

summary.noneNewer: No emulator has a newer build
